part.text:
Implemented the live-reload dev server.

**Changes:**
- `src/serve.ts` — new module with `startDevServer()`: builds site, serves `./dist` over HTTP, injects a WebSocket client script into HTML responses, watches `content/` and `templates/` via chokidar, rebuilds on change (debounced), and broadcasts `reload` to connected `ws` clients when a rebuild completes.
- `src/cli.ts` — added `serve` command with `--content`, `--templates`, `--output`, and `--port` options (default port 3000); build command unchanged.
- `src/serve.test.ts` — tests for script injection, serving/injection, live reload on content change, and static asset content types.
- Added `chokidar`, `ws`, `@types/ws` dependencies.

Verified: `npm run build` (tsc) passes, `npm test` passes, and an end-to-end `node dist/cli.js serve --port 3123` serves injected pages with live reload.
